products.name: X90A Laptop Screen Extender
products.summary: 14-inch IPS portable monitor with 16:9 Full View and 2560 × 1600 resolution for laptop and desktop multi-screen use.
products.description: X90A portable laptop screen extender for compatible Windows and macOS computers. Supports one-cable multi-screen use and Type-C video and audio. The banner lists a price of ₦520,000. Confirm compatibility, stock, delivery, and warranty before purchase.
products.specifications: Model: X90A; screen: 14-inch IPS Full View, 16:9; resolution shown on banner: 2560 × 1600; Windows and macOS compatible; one-cable multi-screen support; Type-C single-cable video and audio; Type-C-to-USB-A video/audio support; laptop and desktop multi-screen use; OSD languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish; ports: Type-C power and full-function Type-C; controls: Power and Menu +/-; listed accessories: Type-C cable, 5V/3A adapter, USB-A converter, USB disk, manual.
products.warranty: Not specified on the product banner; confirm with the supplier.

products.name: X90A 3-in-1 Laptop Screen Extender

products.description: Three-in-one laptop screen extender for a larger mobile workstation. The banner lists one-cable connection support for up to four monitors and a price of ₦590,000. Confirm compatibility, stock, delivery, and warranty before purchase.
